graph_definition: within each full measured charge record, join opposite-sector binary currents iff one residual-directed simple rough-to-rough path flip maps them
optimization_definition: unit-capacity bipartite maximum matching; symmetric fractional edge flow has the same optimum by bipartite matching-polytope integrality

fractional_certificate.construction: put symmetric weight one on each integral matching edge and zero elsewhere

dual_vertex_cover.construction: within every charge record select all vertices of its smaller sector; choose sector zero on ties

controller_audit.path_count: exact vertex degree; useful finite diagnostic but no degree-only lower bound supplies all-subset Hall expansion
controller_audit.crossing_existence: equivalent to positive switching degree and therefore insufficient by itself to bound paired mass
controller_audit.crossing_cluster_or_arm_event: a possible analytic route only if it yields size-uniform neighborhood capacity or a positive-density family of pairable components
controller_audit.required_asymptotic_statement: a size-uniform lower bound on maximum matching density, or an explicit all-size injection/mass transport with bounded congestion

decision.established: For every L3/L4 charge record, maximum single-path matching saturates the smaller logical sector. The matching equals the Bayes numerator and an explicit same-size vertex cover, so the integral and fractional optima are exact.
decision.selector_comparison: Removing the deterministic selector recovers 26 additional pairs at L3 and 38086 at L4 over the selector-stable construction.
decision.finite_only: The exact matching densities are 7/16 at L3 and 11849/32768 at L4. Two sizes and finite saturation do not bound the thermodynamic limit.
decision.not_established: No all-size Hall theorem, bounded-congestion mass transport, or size-uniform positive matching-density event has been proved.
decision.threshold_claim: No square midpoint noncorrectability or decoding-threshold claim is promoted.
